name: discovery-sbml-recovery
title: Discovery-engine SBML recovery — can the cycle build faithful flat SBML models from data?
lead:
A methods investigation. Each study hides a known ground-truth SBML behind its
synthetic trajectories and asks the discovery-engine cycle to rebuild a flat
SBML that matches — graded on trajectory fidelity, structural/parameter
recovery against the oracle, and parsimony. As the loop runs, every capability
gap it hits is logged in a capability ledger and built as a modular
process-bigraph process, so the investigation's second deliverable is a growing
vivarium-style toolkit, not just a verdict.

at_a_glance.role: Baseline — calibrate recovery on linear/bilinear mass-action; establishes trajectory + structural scoring.
Elementary vs reduced rate law — can the loop recover Michaelis-Menten, and which form is parsimonious?
Nonlinearity/bistability — frontier-driven refinement where the data underdetermine the mechanism.
Dynamic structure — recover a limit-cycle topology, the hardest structural recovery.
Adversarial — a stochastic system with no flat-SBML form; passes by being correctly REJECTED.
Follow-up (develop_method) -- moiety-aware regression; builds-on the enzyme method gap.
Follow-up (acquire_data + develop_method) -- ensemble/weak-form; builds-on the oscillator data gap.
Follow-up (develop_method | request_expert) -- rational rate laws; builds-on the gene-switch REFUTATION.
Synthesis -- the reframed claim: recoverability is rate-law-class-, data-richness-, and determinism-relative; builds-on all rungs.

biological_story:
The four scenarios form a difficulty ladder, each stressing a different part of
the build -> compare -> refine loop.

Mass-action (A -> B, reversible binding A + B <-> C) is the floor: linear /
bilinear rates, a handful of reactions. If the cycle can't recover this, nothing
downstream matters — so it calibrates the trajectory and structural scoring.

Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics forces a modelling choice: recover the
elementary mechanism (E + S <-> ES -> E + P) or the reduced saturating rate law.
Both fit the data; parsimony and structural scoring decide which counts as
"recovered", and the loop must be able to propose a non-elementary rate law.

A Hill-function gene switch adds genuine nonlinearity and bistability — the data
alone underdetermine the mechanism, so the cycle's frontier (what the current
candidate fails to explain) has to drive the search, not a one-shot fit.

An oscillator (repressilator / Brusselator) is dynamic structure: a limit cycle
the recovered topology must reproduce qualitatively, not just point-wise. This is
where we expect structural recovery to be hardest and where the capability gaps
(reaction proposal, rate-law fitting) bite most.
question:
Run as a closed build -> simulate -> compare -> refine loop, can the
discovery-engine cycle recover faithful FLAT SBML models from synthetic
time-series targets across a ladder of biological scenarios (mass-action ->
enzyme kinetics -> gene switch -> oscillator), and what modular, vivarium-style
capabilities must be built to close the gaps where it can't?
hypothesis:
The cycle recovers flat SBML to within trajectory tolerance AND
structural/parameter match for mass-action and Michaelis-Menten out of the box;
nonlinearity (Hill switch) and dynamic structure (oscillator) expose specific
missing capabilities (candidate-reaction proposal, rate-law fitting, structural
scoring, non-recoverability detection), each of which, once built as a modular
process, extends the recoverable frontier. Parsimony separates genuine recovery
from overfitting.

executive.what_is_this:
A recovery benchmark: synthetic data from known SBML models across four
biological scenarios, with the discovery-engine cycle driving a closed
build -> simulate -> compare -> refine loop to rebuild flat SBML — plus a
capability ledger that turns each gap into a modular vivarium process.
executive.verdict: In progress -- and the FAILURES are the findings. Grading the REAL recovery search (not the identity baseline) resolves the ladder honestly: mass-action is genuinely recovered from data (nrmse ~0); the stochastic control is correctly rejected; but enzyme-kinetics (conserved-moiety ill-conditioning) and the oscillator (single-trajectory under-determination) are NOT YET recovered -- method/data gaps, not refutations -- and the Hill gene-switch is REFUTED as flat-mass-action-recoverable (non-polynomial kinetics). The cycle thus discovers a RECOVERABILITY FRONTIER and spawns three follow-up directions + a synthesis concept, rather than converging to a hollow 5/5 pass.

decisions_needed.question: Enzyme: adopt moiety-aware regression?
decisions_needed.context: The conserved moiety E+ES makes from-data SINDy rank-deficient (nrmse 0.11 > 0.05). resolution_route: develop_method. Follow-up: recover-enzyme-moiety-aware.

decisions_needed.question: Oscillator: acquire ensemble data + weak-form SINDy?
decisions_needed.context: A single limit-cycle trajectory under-determines the Brusselator (nrmse 0.44). resolution_route: acquire_data + develop_method. Follow-up: recover-oscillator-data-richness.

decisions_needed.question: Gene-switch: extend to rational rate laws, or expert-define the admissible rate-law class?
decisions_needed.context: Hill a/(1+v^3) is non-polynomial; mass-action recovery is REFUTED (nrmse 0.58). resolution_route: develop_method | request_expert. Follow-up: recover-gene-switch-rational-laws.

decisions_needed.question: Adopt the recoverability-frontier as the investigation's reframed claim?
decisions_needed.context: Recoverability is rate-law-class-, data-richness-, and determinism-relative -- not pass/fail. Synthesis study: recoverability-frontier (builds-on all rungs).

scientific_argument.main_claim: A closed build->simulate->compare->refine cycle does not 'recover everything' -- it MAPS A RECOVERABILITY FRONTIER. Faithful flat-SBML recovery from data is relative to the rate-law class (mass-action yes; Hill no, without rational laws), the data richness (one limit-cycle trajectory under-determines structure), and determinism (stochastic/low-copy systems have no flat form). Discovering and delimiting that frontier -- with refutations that open new directions -- is the result.
evidence_for: recover-mass-action: SINDy discovers the 3-reaction network and the fit reproduces trajectories (nrmse ~1e-9) -- genuine from-data recovery.
recover-stochastic-abm: correctly REJECTED as non-recoverable (min poly-RHS R^2 0.0534 << 0.9) -- the detector refuses to overfit noise.
evidence_against: recover-enzyme-kinetics: from-data recovery fails (nrmse 0.11, 31 spurious reactions) -- conserved-moiety ill-conditioning; a method gap.
recover-oscillator: single-trajectory recovery fails (nrmse 0.44, recovered model does not oscillate) -- data under-determination.
recover-gene-switch: REFUTES 'faithful flat SBML = flat mass-action SBML' -- Hill kinetics are non-polynomial (nrmse 0.58, 0 reactions recovered).
caveats: Synthetic targets are an oracle, not biology — success means the method recovered a KNOWN model, not that it discovered real mechanism.
Flat SBML only — hierarchical/submodel composition is out of scope here (that is the sibling sbml-decomposition investigation).
Recovery is scored against ground truth; without the oracle (real data) the same loop has no structural answer key, only trajectory fit.

Earlier the ladder read 5/5 PASS only because the gate graded candidate_model = the TRUTH (identity baseline). The gate now grades the REAL recovery search (candidate_model: '@recovered'), so unmet rungs fail honestly.

competing_frameworks.name: fit-is-enough
competing_frameworks.prediction: matching the target trajectory is sufficient to call a model recovered
competing_frameworks.discriminated_by: structural-recovery + parsimony scoring — a curve-fit that matches the data but invents the wrong reactions fails the structural and parsimony gates

competing_frameworks.name: everything-is-recoverable-flat-SBML
competing_frameworks.prediction: any dynamics, given the right data, can be captured as a flat SBML reaction network
competing_frameworks.discriminated_by: the planned adversarial scenario — a system whose faithful form is not a flat reaction network (non-recoverability detector should flag it)

competing_frameworks.name: no-engine-needed
competing_frameworks.prediction: you don't need the discovery cycle; a one-shot global fitter recovers the model
competing_frameworks.discriminated_by: recover-gene-switch + recover-oscillator, where iterative frontier-driven refinement is what closes the structural gap a one-shot fit misses

studies.name: recover-mass-action
studies.title: Recover mass-action kinetics
studies.question:
Given only synthetic time-series generated from a known mass-action SBML model
(A -> B, reversible binding A + B <-> C), can the discovery-engine cycle rebuild
a flat SBML that reproduces the trajectories and recovers the actual reactions
and rate constants?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model
studies.claim: Recovered faithfully from data: SINDy discovers the 3-reaction network and the fit reproduces the trajectories (nrmse ~1e-9). The cycle rebuilds this flat mass-action SBML from data alone.

studies.name: recover-enzyme-kinetics
studies.title: Recover enzyme kinetics (Michaelis-Menten)
studies.question:
From synthetic data generated by a known enzyme-kinetics model, can the cycle
recover a flat SBML — and does it recover the elementary mechanism
(E + S <-> ES -> E + P) or the reduced Michaelis-Menten rate law, and which is
the parsimonious answer the data actually support?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model
studies.claim: Not yet recovered: the conserved moiety (E+ES const) makes the from-data regression ill-conditioned (nrmse 0.11 > 0.05 tol, 31 spurious reactions). The system IS flat mass-action -- a METHOD gap (needs moiety-aware regression). See follow-up recover-enzyme-moiety-aware.

studies.name: recover-gene-switch
studies.title: Recover a Hill gene switch
studies.question:
From synthetic data of a bistable Hill-repression gene switch, can the cycle
recover a flat SBML that reproduces both stable branches and the nonlinear
(Hill) regulation — a case where the data alone underdetermine the mechanism?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model
studies.claim: REFUTED as flat-MASS-ACTION-recoverable: the switch's Hill kinetics a/(1+v^3) are non-polynomial, so no mass-action network fits (nrmse 0.58, 0 reactions recovered). Recoverability is rate-law-class-relative -- a faithful flat SBML needs rational rate laws. See follow-up recover-gene-switch-rational-laws.

studies.name: recover-oscillator
studies.title: Recover an oscillator
studies.question:
From synthetic data of a limit-cycle oscillator (repressilator or Brusselator),
can the cycle recover a flat SBML whose topology reproduces the oscillation —
period and amplitude — as sustained dynamics, not just a point-wise fit over one
window?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model
studies.claim: Not recovered from a single trajectory: the Brusselator limit-cycle structure is under-determined (nrmse 0.44; recovered model does not oscillate). The system IS flat mass-action -- a DATA-RICHNESS/method gap (ensemble trajectories, weak-form SINDy). See follow-up recover-oscillator-data-richness.

studies.name: recover-stochastic-abm
studies.title: Reject a stochastic system (no flat-SBML form)
studies.question:
Does the recovery pipeline correctly REFUSE to recover a flat SBML from a single
low-copy stochastic trajectory — recognizing the ABM/stochastic boundary where no
deterministic flat-SBML reaction network faithfully fits the data?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model

studies.name: recover-enzyme-moiety-aware
studies.title: Moiety-aware recovery of the enzyme network
studies.question: Does a moiety-aware regression (factoring out the conserved moiety E+ES=const before fitting) recover the Michaelis-Menten enzyme network where the naive from-data SINDy is rank-deficient and fails (nrmse 0.11, 31 spurious)?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model

studies.name: recover-oscillator-data-richness
studies.title: Data richness for limit-cycle structure discovery
studies.question: Does richer data -- an ensemble of trajectories from varied initial conditions, and/or a weak-form (integral) SINDy formulation -- recover the Brusselator limit-cycle network that a single trajectory under-determines (nrmse 0.44)?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model

studies.name: recover-gene-switch-rational-laws
studies.title: Recovery beyond mass-action: rational/Hill rate laws
studies.question: With the flat-MASS-ACTION claim refuted for the bistable toggle (Hill a/(1+v^n) is non-polynomial), can a rational/Hill rate-law library recover it as a faithful (non-mass-action) flat SBML -- and is that the right target, or should the expert define what 'faithful flat SBML' admits for Hill-regulated systems?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model

studies.name: recoverability-frontier
studies.title: The recoverability frontier (synthesis)
studies.question: Across the ladder, what determines whether a system is recoverable as a faithful flat SBML model from data?
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model
studies.claim: Recoverability is rate-law-class-, data-richness-, and determinism-relative -- not a single pass/fail. Mass-action recovers; Michaelis-Menten needs moiety-aware fitting; the oscillator needs richer data; the Hill switch is unrecoverable as mass-action (needs rational laws); the stochastic system has no flat form at all. The frontier -- not a 5/5 pass -- is the finding.
